entities.summary: Sidney Harold Tanenbaum was an American professional basketball player. Playing college basketball for the NYU Violets, he was twice a consensus first-team All-American and twice a Haggerty Award winner. He went on to play professionally for the New York Knicks and the Baltimore Bullets.
